hook.convey: big totals from real life (runs in a cricket season, km on a train trip) → add 4-digit numbers column by column from the right; a place that makes 10 or more sends 1 to the next place

use.hi: Ek team ne IPL season ke pehle half mein 1478 runs banaye, aur doosre half mein 2356 runs. Poore season ke runs nikalne ke liye itne bade numbers jodne padenge. Aaj wahi seekhenge.
use.en: A team scored 1478 runs in the first half of an IPL season and 2356 runs in the second half. To find the runs for the whole season we must add such big numbers. Today we learn that.

use.hi: Ek parivaar ne train se 1360 km aur phir bus se 485 km safar kiya. Kul safar jaanne ke liye 485 ko sahi jagah likhkar jodna hoga.
use.en: A family travelled 1360 km by train and then 485 km by bus. To know the whole journey we must write 485 in the right place and add.

explain.convey: every digit sits in its place (Th H T O); a short number is lined up from the RIGHT, ones under ones, so 48 under 56 of 3256, never under 32

point.hi: 3256 mein 6 ikai ke ghar mein hai, 5 dahai mein, 2 saikde mein aur 3 hazaar mein. Isme 48 jodna ho toh 48 ko right se likhte hain: 8 ikai ke neeche, 4 dahai ke neeche. Yaani ikai ke neeche ikai.
point.en: In 3256 the 6 is in the ones place, 5 in tens, 2 in hundreds and 3 in thousands. To add 48 to it we write 48 from the right: 8 under the ones, 4 under the tens. That is, ones under ones.

prompt.hi: Ab isi 3256 mein 71 jodna hai. 71 ka 7 kis ghar ke neeche likhoge, hazaar ya dahai?
prompt.en: Now we add 71 to this same 3256. Under which place do you write the 7 of 71, thousands or tens?

explain.convey: 2567 + 1385 in columns from the right: ones 7 + 5 = 12 → write 2, carry 1 ten; tens 6 + 8 + 1 = 15 → write 5, carry 1 hundred; hundreds 5 + 3 + 1 = 9; thousands 2 + 1 = 3 → 3952

point.hi: Ikai se shuru karo: 7 + 5 = 12. Yeh 10 ya zyada hai, toh 2 likho aur 1 dahai upar carry karo. Dahai: 6 + 8 + 1 = 15, toh 5 likho aur 1 saikda carry. Saikda: 5 + 3 + 1 = 9. Hazaar: 2 + 1 = 3. Jawab 3952 hai.
point.en: Start with the ones: 7 + 5 = 12. That is 10 or more, so write 2 and carry 1 ten up. Tens: 6 + 8 + 1 = 15, so write 5 and carry 1 hundred. Hundreds: 5 + 3 + 1 = 9. Thousands: 2 + 1 = 3. The answer is 3952.

prompt.hi: Ab isi sawaal mein neeche ka number badal do: 2567 + 1382. Kya ab ikai se dahai mein carry jaayega, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Now change the bottom number in this same sum: 2567 + 1382. Will a carry go from the ones to the tens now, yes or no?

accept: no, the ones make less than 10

explain.convey: 3256 + 48 lined up from the right gives 3304, close to 3256 because 48 is small; an estimate catches a misaligned sum, which lands near 8000

point.hi: 3256 + 48 mein 8 ko 6 ke neeche aur 4 ko 5 ke neeche likha. Ikai 6 + 8 = 14, toh 4 likho, 1 carry. Dahai 5 + 4 + 1 = 10, toh 0 likho, 1 carry. Saikda 2 + 1 = 3, hazaar 3. Jawab 3304 hai. Andaza bhi yahi kehta hai: 48 toh 100 se bhi chhota hai, isliye jawab 3256 se thoda hi aage hai.
point.en: In 3256 + 48 we wrote 8 under the 6 and 4 under the 5. Ones 6 + 8 = 14, so write 4, carry 1. Tens 5 + 4 + 1 = 10, so write 0, carry 1. Hundreds 2 + 1 = 3, thousands 3. The answer is 3304. The estimate says the same: 48 is smaller than even 100, so the answer is only a little past 3256.

prompt.hi: Ab isi 3256 mein 63 jodo. Andaze se batao, jawab 3300 ke paas aayega ya 9500 ke paas?
prompt.en: Now add 63 to this same 3256. By estimate, will the answer be near 3300 or near 9500?

problem.hi: Ek school library mein 3568 kitaabein thi. Library ko 795 nayi kitaabein mili. Ab library mein kitni kitaabein hain?
problem.en: A school library had 3568 books. It received 795 new books. How many books does the library have now?

find.en: the total number of books now

do.hi: 795 ko 3568 ke neeche right se likho

steps.result: 8 ke neeche 5, 6 ke neeche 9, 5 ke neeche 7

why.hi: ikai ke neeche ikai aur dahai ke neeche dahai aani chahiye
why.en: ones must go under ones and tens under tens

do.en: Add the ones, then the tens

steps.result: ikai mein 13 hue, toh 3 likho aur 1 carry; dahai mein 16 hue, toh 6 likho aur 1 carry

why.hi: 10 ya zyada hone par 1 agle ghar mein jaata hai
why.en: when a place makes 10 or more, 1 goes to the next place

prompt.hi: Ab saikda aur hazaar jodo, carry ke saath. Library mein ab kul kitni kitaabein hain?
prompt.en: Now add the hundreds and the thousands, with the carry. How many books does the library have now in all?

why.hi: har ghar apne ghar se juda aur andaza 3600 + 800 = 4400 bhi iske paas hai
why.en: each place was added to its own place, and the estimate 3600 + 800 = 4400 is close to it

prompt.hi: Column mein 4615 aur 78 jodo. Kitna hua?
prompt.en: Add 4615 and 78 in columns. What do you get?

carries in two places → 10 of a place becomes 1 of the next

say.hi: 57 mein 5 dahai hai, hazaar nahi. Isliye 57 ka 7 ikai ke neeche aur 5 dahai ke neeche likhte hain, right se.
say.en: In 57 the 5 is tens, not thousands. So the 7 of 57 goes under the ones and the 5 under the tens, from the right.

prompt.hi: Ikai ke neeche ikai rakhkar 2634 aur 52 jodo. Kitna hua?
prompt.en: Keeping ones under ones, add 2634 and 52. What do you get?

bridgeToNext.hi: Bade numbers jodna aa gaya. Ab ulta kaam karenge: bade numbers ghatana, aur jab upar ka ank chhota ho tab udhaar lena.
bridgeToNext.en: Now we can add big numbers. Next we do the opposite: subtract big numbers, and borrow when the top digit is smaller.

hook.convey: how much is left (coins after buying a game level, runs still needed) → subtract in columns, always bottom digit from top digit; a zero in the middle passes the borrow along and becomes 9

use.hi: Ek video game mein tumhare paas 5000 coins hain, aur naya level 1834 coins ka hai. Level lene ke baad kitne coins bachenge? Iske liye ghatana padega, aur 5000 ke zero mushkil banate hain.
use.en: In a video game you have 5000 coins, and a new level costs 1834 coins. How many coins are left after taking the level? For this we must subtract, and the zeros of 5000 make it tricky.

use.hi: Cricket match jeetne ke liye team ko 402 runs chahiye, aur abhi 167 runs bane hain. Kitne runs baaki hain, yeh ghatakar nikalenge.
use.en: To win the cricket match the team needs 402 runs, and 167 runs are made so far. We find how many runs are still needed by subtracting.

explain.convey: 642 − 318: ones 2 − 8 cannot be done, and the bottom digit is always taken from the top → borrow 1 ten: 4 tens → 3, ones 12; 12 − 8 = 4, 3 − 1 = 2, 6 − 3 = 3 → 324

mustSay.hi: upar wale mein se neeche wala

point.hi: Ikai mein upar 2 hai aur neeche 8. Hum hamesha upar wale mein se neeche wala ghatate hain, aur 2 mein se 8 nahi nikalta. Toh dahai se 1 udhaar lo: 4 dahai 3 ban gayi aur ikai 12 ban gayi. 12 − 8 = 4, dahai 3 − 1 = 2, saikda 6 − 3 = 3. Jawab 324 hai.
point.en: In the ones, 2 is on top and 8 below. We always take the bottom from the top, and 8 cannot come out of 2. So borrow 1 ten: 4 tens become 3 and the ones become 12. 12 − 8 = 4, tens 3 − 1 = 2, hundreds 6 − 3 = 3. The answer is 324.

prompt.hi: Isi tarah column mein 752 − 236 karo. Kitna bacha?
prompt.en: In the same way, do 752 − 236 in columns. What is left?

explain.convey: 402 − 167: ones need a borrow but tens is 0 → borrow from hundreds: 4 → 3, tens 10; tens lends 1 → tens 9, ones 12; 12 − 7 = 5, 9 − 6 = 3, 3 − 1 = 2 → 235; the zero ends as 9, not 10

point.hi: Ikai mein 2 mein se 7 nahi nikalta, aur dahai mein 0 hai. Toh saikde se udhaar lo: 4 saikde 3 ban gaye aur dahai 10 bani. Phir dahai ne 1 ikai ko diya, toh dahai 9 bachi aur ikai 12 bani. Ab 12 − 7 = 5, 9 − 6 = 3, 3 − 1 = 2. Jawab 235 hai, aur beech ka zero 9 bana.
point.en: In the ones, 7 cannot come out of 2, and the tens is 0. So borrow from the hundreds: 4 hundreds become 3 and the tens become 10. Then the tens gives 1 to the ones, so 9 tens remain and the ones become 12. Now 12 − 7 = 5, 9 − 6 = 3, 3 − 1 = 2. The answer is 235, and the middle zero became 9.

prompt.hi: Isi tarah column mein 305 − 128 karo. Kitna bacha?
prompt.en: In the same way, do 305 − 128 in columns. What is left?

explain.convey: check a subtraction by adding back: answer + bottom number = top number (235 + 167 = 402); a wrong answer fails the check

point.hi: Ghatane ka jawab jodkar check karte hain. Jawab 235 mein neeche wala 167 jodo: ikai 5 + 7 = 12, toh 2 likho, 1 carry; dahai 3 + 6 + 1 = 10, toh 0 likho, 1 carry; saikda 2 + 1 + 1 = 4. Yeh 402 hai, wahi upar wala number. Toh 402 − 167 = 235 sahi hai.
point.en: We check a subtraction answer by adding. Add the bottom number 167 to the answer 235: ones 5 + 7 = 12, so write 2, carry 1; tens 3 + 6 + 1 = 10, so write 0, carry 1; hundreds 2 + 1 + 1 = 4. That is 402, the same top number. So 402 − 167 = 235 is right.

prompt.hi: {friend} ne 6004 − 2357 ka jawab 4647 likha. Kya 4647 aur 2357 jodne par 6004 aata hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: {friend} wrote 4647 as the answer to 6004 − 2357. Do 4647 and 2357 add up to 6004, yes or no?

problem.hi: Video game mein 5000 coins the. 1834 coins ka ek level liya. Kitne coins bache?
problem.en: There were 5000 coins in a video game. A level costing 1834 coins was taken. How many coins are left?

do.hi: 1834 ko 5000 ke neeche right se likho aur ikai dekho
do.en: Write 1834 under 5000 from the right and look at the ones

steps.result: 0 mein se 4 nahi nikalta, udhaar chahiye

why.hi: dahai aur saikde mein bhi 0 hai, isliye udhaar hazaar se aayega
why.en: the tens and hundreds are also 0, so the borrow comes from the thousands

do.hi: Hazaar se udhaar lo aur aage pahunchao
do.en: Borrow from the thousands and pass it along

why.hi: beech ke har zero ne 1 aage diya, isliye woh 9 bana, 10 nahi
why.en: each middle zero passed 1 along, so it became 9, not 10

prompt.hi: Ab ikai se hazaar tak har ghar mein ghatao. Kitne coins bache?
prompt.en: Now subtract in every place from the ones to the thousands. How many coins are left?

answer.en: 3166 coins are left in the game

why.hi: 1834 + 3166 = 5000 aata hai, toh jawab sahi hai

prompt.hi: Isha ke paas ₹826 the. ₹459 ki kitaab kharidi gayi. Kitne rupaye bache?
prompt.en: Isha had ₹826. A book costing ₹459 was bought. How many rupees are left?

prompt.en: A school had 700 chairs. 264 chairs were sent to another hall. How many chairs are left?

prompt.en: 8003 tickets were printed for a fair, and 4567 were sold. How many tickets are left?

ladder.why: quick recall: a round subtraction 600 − 250 before borrowing work
4-digit subtraction with one borrow in the ones
contrast 225 vs 375 → bottom from top, check by adding
error spot across two zeros → the thousands must go down by 1
borrow across zeros in a money story, ₹6,002 − ₹2,785

remediation.move: ten-rods and ones: 6 rods and 2 ones on the mat, take away 3 rods and 8 ones → 8 ones cannot come from 2, so open one rod into 10 ones; ask where the extra ones came from

say.hi: 62 mein se 38 nikaalte waqt 2 ikai mein se 8 nahi nikalti, toh ek dahai kholkar 12 ikai banao. Hamesha upar wale mein se neeche wala ghatate hain.
say.en: Taking 38 from 62, 8 ones cannot come out of 2 ones, so open one ten to make 12 ones. We always take the bottom from the top.

prompt.hi: Upar wale ank mein se neeche wala ghatao. Column mein 534 − 286 karo, kitna bacha?
prompt.en: Take the bottom digit from the top one. Do 534 − 286 in columns: what is left?

remediation.move: play money: three ₹100 notes → change one ₹100 for ten ₹10 → change one ₹10 for ten ₹1; write what is left in each place after each change → 2 hundreds, 9 tens, 10 ones; compare with the written borrowing

say.hi: ₹300 mein ek ₹100 ka note das ₹10 ke notes se badlo, phir ek ₹10 ko das ₹1 se. Ab 2 sau, 9 das aur 10 ek hain, 10 das nahi.
say.en: In ₹300, change one ₹100 note for ten ₹10 notes, then one ₹10 for ten ₹1. Now there are 2 hundreds, 9 tens and 10 ones, not 10 tens.

prompt.hi: Column mein 600 − 245 karo. Udhaar dene ke baad beech ka 0, 9 banta hai. Kitna bacha?
prompt.en: Do 600 − 245 in columns. After lending, the middle 0 becomes 9. What is left?

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab jodna aur ghatana dono aate hain. Agla kaam: kisi kahani mein pehchanna ki jodna hai ya ghatana.
bridgeToNext.en: Now we can both add and subtract. Next: telling, in a story, whether to add or to subtract.

hook.convey: shopping and travel stories → first find what is known: both parts (whole missing → add) or the whole and one part (a part missing → subtract); a word like 'more' or 'in all' does not decide

use.hi: Tumhe ₹1400 ki ek cricket kit chahiye, aur gullak mein ₹850 hain. Aur kitne rupaye chahiye? Yahan 'aur' sunkar jodna nahi, pehle sochna hai ki kya pata hai.
use.en: You want a cricket kit costing ₹1400, and your piggy bank has ₹850. How much more do you need? Here we do not add just because we hear 'more'; first we think about what is known.

use.hi: Ek parivaar car se 1620 km door naani ke ghar ja raha hai. Pehle din 875 km chale. Baaki safar jodne se milega ya ghatane se, yeh aaj pehchanna seekhenge.
use.en: A family is driving 1620 km by car to their grandmother's house. On the first day they drove 875 km. Today we learn to tell whether the rest of the trip comes from adding or subtracting.

explain.convey: whole-part picture: the whole is ₹1200 (cycle price), one part ₹750 is saved, the other part is empty → the operation follows from which piece is missing

point.hi: Beech mein poora hai: ₹1200 ki cycle. Ek hissa ₹750 jama hai. Doosra hissa khaali hai, wahi humein nahi pata. Toh yahan poora pata hai aur ek hissa gayab hai.
point.en: In the middle is the whole: a cycle for ₹1200. One part, ₹750, is saved. The other part is empty; that is what we do not know. So here the whole is known and one part is missing.

prompt.hi: Cycle ₹1200 ki hai aur ₹750 jama hain. Khaali hissa nikalne ke liye 1200 aur 750 ko jodoge ya ghatoge?
prompt.en: The cycle costs ₹1200 and ₹750 is saved. To find the empty part, will you add or subtract 1200 and 750?

explain.convey: both parts known (train 1360 km, bus 485 km), the whole trip missing → add the parts

point.hi: Yahan dono hisse pata hain: train se 1360 km aur bus se 485 km. Kul safar, yaani poora, gayab hai. Jab dono hisse pata hon aur poora gayab ho, toh hisse jodte hain.
point.en: Here both parts are known: 1360 km by train and 485 km by bus. The total trip, the whole, is missing. When both parts are known and the whole is missing, we add the parts.

prompt.hi: Train se 1360 km aur bus se 485 km safar hua. Kul safar kitne km ka hua?
prompt.en: The trip was 1360 km by train and 485 km by bus. How many km was the whole trip?

explain.convey: 'how much more' with the whole (₹1400 kit) and one part (₹850) known → a part is missing → subtract, even though the question says 'more'; check: part + part = whole

point.hi: Cricket kit ka poora daam ₹1400 hai, aur tumhare paas ₹850 hain. Sawaal mein aur kitne aaya, par shabd se faisla nahi hota. Poora pata hai, ek hissa gayab hai, toh poora − hissa karna hai.
point.en: The full price of the cricket kit is ₹1400, and you have ₹850. The question says how much more, but the word does not decide. The whole is known and a part is missing, so we do whole − part.

prompt.hi: Cricket kit ₹1400 ki hai aur tumhare paas ₹850 hain. Aur kitne rupaye chahiye?
prompt.en: The cricket kit costs ₹1400 and you have ₹850. How many more rupees do you need?

problem.hi: Pooja ka parivaar car se 1620 km door naani ke ghar ja raha hai. Pehle din 875 km chale. Aur kitne km chalana hai?
problem.en: Pooja's family is driving 1620 km to visit her grandmother. On the first day they drive 875 km. How many more km must they drive?

do.hi: Pehle dekho kya pata hai aur kya gayab hai
do.en: First see what is known and what is missing

steps.result: poora 1620 km pata hai, ek hissa 875 km pata hai, baaki hissa gayab

why.hi: aur kitne ka matlab poore safar mein se bacha hua hissa hai
why.en: how many more means the part of the whole trip still left

do.hi: Hissa gayab hai toh ghatana hai; pehle andaza lagao
do.en: A part is missing, so subtract; first estimate

why.hi: andaze se pata chalega ki jawab theek jagah ke paas hai
why.en: the estimate tells us whether the answer lands in the right place

prompt.hi: Ab column mein 1620 − 875 karo, udhaar ke saath. Aur kitne km chalana hai?
prompt.en: Now do 1620 − 875 in columns, with borrowing. How many more km must they drive?

why.hi: 875 + 745 = 1620 aata hai, aur 745 andaze 700 ke paas hai
why.en: 875 + 745 = 1620, and 745 is close to the estimate 700

prompt.hi: Sohan ko ₹1250 ki cycle chahiye. Sohan ke paas ₹780 hain. Aur kitne rupaye chahiye?
prompt.en: Sohan wants a cycle costing ₹1250. Sohan has ₹780. How many more rupees are needed?

prompt.hi: Library mein kul milakar 2400 kitaabein hain. Unme 1650 Hindi ki hain, baaki English ki. English ki kitni kitaabein hain?
prompt.en: A library has 2400 books altogether. 1650 of them are Hindi books, the rest are English. How many English books are there?

ladder.why: both parts known (train and bus tickets) → whole missing → add
travel there and back → add one way, then the same again
budget minus two expenses → add the parts spent, then whole − part

remediation.move: bar model on the cricket kit the child already heard: whole ₹1400, known part ₹850, empty part for the unknown → ask: whole missing or part missing → part missing → whole − part → check part + part = whole

say.hi: Pehle dekho poora pata hai ya nahi. Cricket kit ka ₹1400 poora hai aur ₹850 ek hissa, toh gayab hissa poora − hissa hai, chahe sawaal mein aur kitne ho.
say.en: First see whether the whole is known. The cricket kit price ₹1400 is the whole and ₹850 a part, so the missing part is whole − part, even if the question says how much more.

prompt.hi: Pencil box ₹540 ka hai aur tumhare paas ₹375 hain. Aur kitne rupaye chahiye?
prompt.en: A pencil box costs ₹540 and you have ₹375. How many more rupees do you need?
